|lore=Padawan learner promoted to Jedi Knight after his encounter with Darth Maul. Has sworn to train Anakin Skywalker, even if the Jedi Council forbids it.
|game_text=Deploys -1 to [Episode I] sites. During a battle (or duel) with a Dark Jedi, unless Obi-Wan’s Journal on table, may use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn duel, weapon, or battle destiny. Once per game, may take Disarmed into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 5.

|notes=The [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (Original 2005)|2005 Gold Edition wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Deploy rises from 6 to 7. The remaster removes the pilot bonus and the option to treat the control phase on your Disarmed as a move phase. It adds an Episode I site deployment discount. The original once-per-turn local destiny cancellation becomes a paid action during a battle or duel with a Dark Jedi and names duel, weapon and battle destiny. Both retain the Obi-Wan’s Journal exception, Disarmed search and attrition immunity. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=1 Players Committee Gold Edition sheet, p. 1, slip 11]. [[:File:VS11O-11-ObiWan_Kenobi_Jedi_Knight.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 11]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154617/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards11.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards11.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to cards #8 and #27 on 25 June 2007); page 2, slip 11.
